scope: Disconnected BF16 bridge source/host/resource only; no quantizer, I4 GEMM, model or serving integration in this tree.
actual_control_flow: post_attention_*_stage: projected load -> normalize(post) BF16 -> residual_add BF16 -> normalize(pre) BF16 -> existing E4quant -> persist updated residual
post_feedforward_stage: normalize(postFFN) BF16 -> residual_add BF16 -> layergate BF16 -> persist residual

prefix_bridge.input: Four original sliding blocked Output or four full canonical[P128,H] projections, post/pre normweights, mutable blocked Residual
prefix_bridge.unchanged_prefix: Original loaders, normalize(post), residual load/add, normalize(pre), using original ops_norm_quarters helpers
prefix_bridge.output: Canonical BF16[P512,H] immediately before quantize_shards; updated Residual persisted after output
prefix_bridge.mapping: Same-wire Q4/P128 relabel: p=128*q+64*c+2*r+j. Then real to_dm from H480 shards to Slice[P512/128,P512%64], Cluster[P512/64%2], localH; canonical HBM store. No E4 code or dequantization.

geglu_bridge.input: Current JoinedOutput = [FfnProjection,P512/256,L/240,P512%256,L%240], unchanged reciprocal up/gate globals
geglu_bridge.reuse: Visibility-only pub(crate) global_dm and geglu_tile_into; scale_tile body untouched/private. Preserve original joined plane views, two globalDM loads and four chunk/2tile loops before amax.
geglu_bridge.rounding: Each UP/GATE×global roundsBF16, gate/√2 ->Erf ->+1 ->×gate inF32, product×up then originalDivF2 thenBF16. No fused arithmetic or clamp change.
geglu_bridge.mapping: Per chunk0..3, real DM join from Slice[L/960,P64/4], local[P64%4,L960] to Slice[P64,1#4], localL. Canonical target selects P512%256=64 at64*chunk, preserving both token clusters. No output alias or same-wire transpose.

invariants: Original control kernels/bodies unchanged; helper visibility-only edits proven byte-identical
No original native-E4 row dequant factor applied to provided-weight I4 results
Post-FFN layergate remains only in the unchanged tail, never moved into prefix
Every512 row written exactly once; canonical outputs and residual require distinct HBM owners
All added DM movement, BF16 HBM writes and future rereads charged, no hidden fence exclusion

resource_gate.report: Each complete bridge task, output movement, actual SRAM peak/lifetimes and DramStack. No extrapolated complete-FFN saving. Any spill/failure retained; no geometry sweep.

future_correctness: Must independently compare canonical BF16 boundaries/residual against original same-input helper/control, all rows/permutations/padding and supplied signed globals; this resource phase does not prove runtime bits.
